sundai:fc:56.question: The village looked completely _____ after the war.
sundai:fc:56.fullSentence: The village looked completely desolate after the war.

sundai:fc:57.hint: ray(光線)、radium(ラジウム)と同語源
sundai:fc:57.question: 「放射線」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:57.fullSentence: Too much radiation can be dangerous to health.
sundai:fc:57.explanation: radiation: 放射線。radical: 急進的な、根本的な。

sundai:fc:58.question: The government proposed a _____ change to the tax system.
sundai:fc:58.fullSentence: The government proposed a radical change to the tax system.
sundai:fc:58.explanation: radical: 急進的な、根本的な。

sundai:fc:59.question: 「一致する、同時に起こる」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:59.fullSentence: It's odd that our birthdays coincide.
sundai:fc:59.explanation: coincide: 一致する、同時に起こる。coincidence: 偶然の一致。

sundai:fc:60.question: A strange _____ happened on my way home yesterday.
sundai:fc:60.fullSentence: A strange incident happened on my way home yesterday.

sundai:fc:61.question: She refused to _____ to unfair rules.
sundai:fc:61.fullSentence: She refused to defy unfair rules.

sundai:fc:62.question: The soldiers were _____ for their political beliefs.
sundai:fc:62.fullSentence: The soldiers were persecuted for their political beliefs.

sundai:fc:63.question: 「時代錯誤」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:63.fullSentence: Using a typewriter today seems like an anachronism.
sundai:fc:63.explanation: anachronism: 時代錯誤。chronic: 慢性の。chronicle: 年代記。

sundai:fc:64.question: He suffers from a _____ illness that never fully goes away.
sundai:fc:64.fullSentence: He suffers from a chronic illness that never fully goes away.

sundai:fc:65.question: The king wanted to expand his _____.
sundai:fc:65.fullSentence: The king wanted to expand his domain.
sundai:fc:65.explanation: domain: 領域。dom「支配する」語根。

sundai:fc:66.question: 「支配する」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:66.fullSentence: One company dominates the smartphone market.
sundai:fc:66.explanation: dominate: 支配する。dominant: 優性の。

sundai:fc:67.hint: 「謙虚な」という意味の形容詞を入れましょう。
sundai:fc:67.question: Please be _____ about your opinion; don't be shy.
sundai:fc:67.fullSentence: Please be humble about your opinion; don't be shy.

sundai:fc:68.question: 「辱める、恥をかかせる」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:68.fullSentence: He was humiliated in front of the whole class.
sundai:fc:68.explanation: humiliate: 辱める。humid: 湿っている。

sundai:fc:69.question: Singapore has a hot and _____ climate all year round.
sundai:fc:69.fullSentence: Singapore has a hot and humid climate all year round.

sundai:fc:70.question: As an only child, he will _____ the entire family fortune.
sundai:fc:70.fullSentence: As an only child, he will inherit the entire family fortune.
sundai:fc:70.explanation: inherit: 相続する。heir(相続人)、heredity(遺伝)、heritage(遺産)と同語源。

sundai:fc:71.question: 「固有の、本来備わっている」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:71.fullSentence: Risk is inherent in any business venture.
sundai:fc:71.explanation: inherent: 固有の、本来備わっている。

sundai:fc:72.question: Cultural sites are an important part of our national _____.
sundai:fc:72.fullSentence: Cultural sites are an important part of our national heritage.

sundai:fc:73.question: 「くっつく、固執する」を意味する単語はどれ？（to を伴う）
sundai:fc:73.fullSentence: We must adhere to the rules of the competition.
sundai:fc:73.explanation: adhere to: くっつく、固執する。adherent: 信奉者。

sundai:fc:74.question: His argument was logical and _____.
sundai:fc:74.fullSentence: His argument was logical and coherent.

sundai:fc:75.hint: 「見えない」という意味の形容詞を入れましょう。
sundai:fc:75.question: Bacteria are too small to be _____ to the naked eye.
sundai:fc:75.fullSentence: Bacteria are too small to be visible to the naked eye, so they are basically invisible.

sundai:fc:76.hint: vise「見る」語根から派生した意外な単語
sundai:fc:76.question: 「即興でやる」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:76.fullSentence: The band had to improvise when the singer got sick.
sundai:fc:76.explanation: improvise: 即興でやる。revise: 改訂する。supervisor: 監督者。

sundai:fc:77.question: This new _____ can measure your heart rate accurately.
sundai:fc:77.fullSentence: This new device can measure your heart rate accurately.
sundai:fc:77.explanation: device: 装置(名詞)。devise: 工夫する(動詞)。

sundai:fc:78.question: 「予言する」（動詞）を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:78.fullSentence: It is impossible to prophesy the future with certainty.
sundai:fc:78.explanation: prophesy(動詞): 予言する。prophecy(名詞): 予言。

sundai:fc:79.question: The UN's _____ helped stop the conflict.
sundai:fc:79.fullSentence: The UN's intervention helped stop the conflict.

sundai:fc:80.question: 「型にはまった」を意味する単語はどれ？
sundai:fc:80.explanation: conventional: 型にはまった。convention: 慣習、集会。
